callgrindEventCaveat.finding: VEX register bit-test lowering writes the operand to temporary guest stack memory and performs a memory-form operation. Callgrind Dr/Dw can therefore contain synthetic instrumentation-visible accesses absent from native machine operands. Do not interpret them as PMU retired memory operations. Direct stack metrics separately match disassembled rbp/rsp operands.
callgrindEventCaveat.caveat: Instruction counts and opcode-local source contrasts remain separate from physical-cycle attribution. Per-opcode synthetic-event differences must not be mistaken for VM allocations.
